findings.title: Ordinary quickstart invoked initialization despite committed lockfile
findings.severity_basis: The advertised first-run path fails before a normal locked build.
findings.preconditions: New clone follows the earlier bootstrap instruction.
evidence: README.md and docs/installation.md at review target
findings.impact: The advertised first-run path fails before a normal locked build.
findings.recommended_remediation: Use the two-binary locked build and isolated fake recipe; retain lockfile.
findings.residual_risk: No release install or full package matrix was rerun.

findings.title: Platform and architecture prose lagged the integrated implementation
findings.severity_basis: Future-only or incomplete platform statements can mislead support and security assumptions.
findings.preconditions: Reader uses earlier architecture/platform guide as current support matrix.
findings.impact: Future-only or incomplete platform statements can mislead support and security assumptions.
findings.recommended_remediation: Adopt the explicit implementation/native/interactive matrix without inferring parity.
findings.residual_risk: Independent review of R-authored security-relevant support wording remains required.

findings.title: Current-commit evidence claim conflicted with historical and skipped jobs
findings.severity_basis: Historical tests or skipped jobs could be mistaken for current executed approval.
findings.preconditions: A reader treats the old all-green/current-containing-commit language or old preflight as current truth.
findings.impact: Historical tests or skipped jobs could be mistaken for current executed approval.
findings.recommended_remediation: Keep source and suite identities and preserve original failures; scope every current statement.
findings.residual_risk: Reports and their validators are authored by R, not an independent attestation service.

findings.title: Contributor reporting instructions did not match available channels
findings.severity_basis: Confusing channels can delay or misroute reports.
evidence: Repository API: private vulnerability reporting enabled
findings.impact: Confusing channels can delay or misroute reports.
findings.recommended_remediation: Use public issues for non-sensitive questions and enabled private vulnerability reporting for sensitive reports.
findings.residual_risk: No response SLA, guaranteed triage time or changed disclosure setting is implied.

findings.title: R smoke selection includes zero-test libraries and checks exit codes only
findings.severity_basis: A green harness alone cannot prove every named package was tested or assert the expected fake output.
findings.preconditions: R smoke uses --lib for Graph and Effects, whose selected targets execute zero tests.
evidence: R_FROZEN_SOURCE_SMOKE.json: 9 policy + 7 protocol + 5 Composition, 0 Graph, 0 Effects
findings.impact: A green harness alone cannot prove every named package was tested or assert the expected fake output.
findings.recommended_remediation: Select inspected bounded integration targets, require positive counts, and assert the expected fake result; obtain independent review of verification changes.
findings.residual_risk: R inspected changed=true in the current log and makes no fresh Graph/Effects claim. A proposed harness correction was tool-blocked and was not applied.

findings.title: Aggregate upstream tool-list budget requires further verification
findings.severity_basis: The visible count check is after collection. Without verified SDK aggregate bounds, transient resource use is not established as bounded by 512 tools. No impact or exploit was reproduced.
findings.preconditions: An owner-configured external MCP provider is admitted and tool discovery runs.
findings.impact: The visible count check is after collection. Without verified SDK aggregate bounds, transient resource use is not established as bounded by 512 tools. No impact or exploit was reproduced.
findings.recommended_remediation: Review SDK cumulative pagination/frame budgets and enforce the declared aggregate limit before materialization when necessary; validate with bounded contract tests and independent review.
findings.residual_risk: The SDK or transport may already impose sufficient bounds; R has not established that fact.

findings.title: Independent eligibility and R-authored assurance changes are not adopted
findings.severity_basis: The author cannot provide independent release approval for its own security-relevant assurance changes.
findings.preconditions: R reports on source from A-I while also authoring documentation and verification tooling.
evidence: No independent reviewer attestation is present
R16 remains false/open in all new records
findings.impact: The author cannot provide independent release approval for its own security-relevant assurance changes.
findings.recommended_remediation: Assess R provenance, review R changes and independently validate relevant corrections before adopting a scoped closure.
findings.residual_risk: This is an AI-assisted repository review, not an external security audit.

findings.title: Requested review depth was not completed for all mandatory boundaries
findings.severity_basis: The missing direct inspection and unexecuted platform/supply-chain work cannot be converted into a no-findings verdict.
findings.preconditions: The complete twelve-area R16 review is being evaluated.
evidence: Tool-blocked requests involving PlanVault, Graph/Effects, portal ranges and additional test selection
Successful source-read range index in R16_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json
findings.impact: The missing direct inspection and unexecuted platform/supply-chain work cannot be converted into a no-findings verdict.
findings.recommended_remediation: Complete the missing inspections and independent verification in an environment where the operations are permitted; retain the present partial status.
findings.residual_risk: Existing I/G receipts were verified without rerunning them. Tool blocks were not bypassed.

findings.title: No main branch protection or ruleset was observed
findings.severity_basis: The observed repository settings do not enforce those requirements at the branch level. This is a governance observation, not evidence of an unauthorized change.
findings.preconditions: The repository relies on server-side enforcement of maintainer review and required checks.
evidence: GitHub main protection endpoint returned 404 Branch not protected
Repository rulesets endpoint returned an empty array
findings.impact: The observed repository settings do not enforce those requirements at the branch level. This is a governance observation, not evidence of an unauthorized change.
findings.recommended_remediation: Choose and configure an appropriate branch ruleset/required-check/review policy or document explicit risk acceptance.
findings.residual_risk: R did not change repository settings or infer policy from a green workflow.

findings.title: Physical and interactive platform release gates remain open
findings.severity_basis: Hosted/headless success does not establish the outstanding physical and unlocked-desktop conditions.
findings.preconditions: A production/release-wide desktop support claim is proposed.
evidence: docs/platforms.md and native Windows source-specific evidence
findings.impact: Hosted/headless success does not establish the outstanding physical and unlocked-desktop conditions.
findings.recommended_remediation: Complete the existing authorized physical/interactive gate matrix before a corresponding release claim.
findings.residual_risk: No fake display, shared graphical authority or cross-OS inference is accepted as replacement.
